summary: Radnostix Inc. 8-K reports that, on September 28, 2026, the company and wholly owned subsidiary International Isotopes Fluorine Products entered an Asset Purchase Agreement with Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. and its subsidiary HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. as buyer. The buyers will purchase assets tied to a planned depleted-uranium deconversion and fluorine-extraction plant in Hobbs, New Mexico, including NRC Material License SUB-1011, a New Mexico air permit, patents, and General Dynamics Sequoyah conversion-plant documentation. Consideration is $9.5 million cash plus $4 million of restricted Nano Nuclear common stock, priced by pre-closing volume-weighted average price; buyer assumes only post-closing liabilities.
